flanger→signal-processing DEPENDS_ON: The flanger's operational mechanism IS signal processing — a delay line modulated by an LFO, producing comb filtering through constructive/destructive interference. Remove signal processing as the operational framework and the flanger's specific mechanism (delay, modulation, interference) has no working identity. This is concrete mechanism, not meta-level sayability.

flanger→digital-audio SERVES: Law 8d asks 'for whose sake?' — the flanger is built and maintained for the sake of digital-audio production. It persists as effect plugins, hardware units, and DSP code used in audio workflows. The servant (flanger) points at the master (digital-audio production). This is teleology, not dependency or domain-mere-containment.

A colophon is a paratextual element that exists only as part of a book or codex. Remove the book and the colophon has no substrate to attach to — it ceases to operate as a colophon. This is a constitutive dependency: the colophon needs the book to function.

Garden tools are implements operated by hand for small-scale cultivation, distinguished from agricultural machinery by manual operation. The definition pins garden-tool as a class of hand-operated implements. A garden-tool IS a hand-tool (a kind that uses manual operation for gardening). This is the nearest kind.

Pinned sense holds: the comb-filter's accepted-pending definition is 'a signal processing technique' and its entire mechanism — summing a signal with a delayed, scaled copy to produce a frequency response of equally spaced peaks/nulls — is internal to signal processing (delay, superposition, frequency-domain behavior are SP concepts). Removal test: strip signal processing as the operational framework and the comb-filter has no mechanism to operate by. Same shape as limiter->signal-processing which I advanced: a component whose purpose is internal to the practice. It has no other specific built-for master (used across flanging, echo cancellation, EQ), so the discipline is the right dependency target, not an ambient formalism like mathematics.

Law 11d sense mismatch. The modulation entry's accepted definition pins the COMMUNICATION sense: properties of a carrier signal varied in proportion to an information signal, a high-frequency carrier chosen for transmission, persistence in communication standards and transmitting hardware. The flanger note pins a different sense: an LFO varying the delay-TIME parameter of a delay line. There is no carrier, no information signal, no channel in a flanger — that is parameter modulation of a DSP effect, not carrier modulation. The removal test also fails: remove the communication modulation technique and the flanger still operates (the original flanger was an analog tape effect; DSP flangers use none of AM/FM carrier modulation). The flanger's genuine dependency is the modulation SOURCE — lfo, which the filer has separately filed — not the modulation technique entry as defined. STRIKE.

Pinned sense holds: the flanger's accepted definition fixes its mechanism (delay line, LFO-modulated delay time, comb filtering via constructive/destructive interference) and its persistence as a DSP recipe in code and plugins. The delay line, interference math, and modulation of a signal parameter are all signal-processing concepts; remove signal processing as the operational framework and the flanger has no mechanism to operate by. Same shape as limiter->signal-processing, which I advanced on the same internal-to-the-practice test. The note describes flanger->signal-processing in the correct direction (technique -> discipline), and the removal is a present-tense operational failure, not a chronology argument.

SERVES requires the specific built-for purpose (Law 8d), and digital-audio (per its accepted definition, a signal ENCODING method: samples, file formats, streams) is not the flanger's master. The flanger's purpose — the sweeping jet effect in recorded music — is medium-independent and PREDATES digital audio: the effect was discovered on flapping analog tape, and analog tape flangers and analog hardware flangers still operate on analog signals. The note's factual claim 'no one uses a flanger outside of digital audio contexts' is false, and its cited evidence ('persists as effect plugins, hardware units, and DSP code') is a persistence-mechanism argument, not a built-for-purpose one — it even lists hardware units. Contrast the genuinely digital-specific SERVES edges accepted on this target (audio-dithering prevents quantization artifacts; audio-compression makes the digital medium practical): the flanger is not digital-specific. The correct master would be an audio/music production entry, not the encoding medium.

Pinned sense holds against the colophon's accepted definition: its parameters are (1) must appear at or near the end of a codex, (2) must document some aspect of the book materializing process. Both require a book — remove books as the container and the colophon has neither a place to appear nor an object to document, so it ceases to operate as a document feature and degrades to a bare statement. This is the same constitutive embedded-marker logic the court already accepted in colophon->writing (ACCEPTED): without the medium, no colophon exists. Direction is correct (feature -> container it operates within), and the removal is a present-tense operational failure, not a chronology argument.

SERVES holds here where it failed for the classic flanger: the spectral flanger has NO analog form. Its mechanism is a modulated phase ramp across STFT bins — FFT-based spectral manipulation that operates only on digitized samples, so its built-for purpose (spectral flanging) can be realized only within digital audio. Remove digital-audio and the technique's entire practice vanishes, unlike the delay-line flanger which persists on analog tape and analog hardware. This is the same family the court has already accepted: phase-vocoder SERVES digital-audio (a spectral manipulation procedure built for digital-audio applications) and pitch-shift SERVES digital-audio are both ACCEPTED. Servant (spectral-flanger) points at master (digital-audio), the domain in which its sole purpose is sustained.

Sound new construct, made-side: the comb-filter as a deliberate signal-processing technique (a filter design for flanging, echo cancellation, EQ) is human-made and built to persist — the accompanying definition fixes its mechanism (delay + superposition, y[n]=x[n]+alpha*x[n-d]) and its persistence (DSP plugins, hardware units, audio-engineering literature). The scope carves a real, distinct kind: it is not the flanger (which is an effect built around this response) and no comb-filter entry is held. Referent THING is correct — a technique is a made thing. Law 1-3 satisfied; no collision.

Sound new construct, made-side: an LFO is a human-made electronic/algorithmic signal source built to persist as synth circuits, DSP code, and documented engineering specs. The scope carves a distinct kind with real parameters (sub-audible band 0.01-20 Hz, waveform type, modulation role) and is explicitly distinguished from audio-rate oscillators (not heard directly; modulates pitch/amplitude/cutoff/delay). Referent THING is correct — a circuit or algorithm is a made thing. No name collision; if an oscillator entry exists, lfo is a kind of it (an INSTANCE_OF rung), not a duplicate of it. Law 1-3 satisfied.

Definition carves the construct properly: what an LFO is (signal generator of periodic waveforms in the sub-audible 0.01-20 Hz band), its parameters (waveform type sine/square/triangle/saw, rate/frequency, modulation target — pitch/vibrato, amplitude/tremolo, cutoff/wah, delay/flanging), its explicit distinction from audio-rate oscillators (not heard directly; modulates rather than sounds), and a concrete persistence mechanism (analog synth circuits, lookup-table/numerical DSP algorithms, engineering specs). Trailer is present and well-formed. No Law 4 gap.

Definition carves the construct properly: what a comb-filter is (frequency response of equally spaced spectral peaks and nulls), its mechanism with an explicit mathematical form (y[n]=x[n]+alpha*x[n-d]), its parameters (delay d sets tooth spacing, scaling alpha sets amplitude), and a concrete persistence mechanism (DSP plugins, hardware units, published audio-engineering specifications). Trailer present and well-formed. The parenthetical 'feedback/gain' is a mild imprecision (alpha is feedforward gain), not a carving failure. No Law 4 gap.

Changed from STRIKE on reconsideration against settled board practice. The court has ACCEPTED a large family of technique to signal-processing DEPENDS_ON edges on exactly this reasoning: 'remove signal processing (FFT, filtering, delay, spectral analysis) and the technique stops operating / has no means to operate' — noise-reduction, equalization, audio-codec, fir-filter, butterworth-filter, mel-cepstral-distortion, a-weighting, spectral-gating all stand ACCEPTED. My earlier STRIKE read the target as the institutional field (8c meta-frame), but the removal test as the court applies it removes the body of operating methods, not the field's institutional existence — and the comb-filter's entire mechanism (delayed-scaled superposition, frequency-response shaping) is precisely that body of methods. Consistent with my own earlier ADVANCE votes on pitch-detection and audio-feature to this same target ('not meta-level; genuine operational dependency').

Pinned sense fails against the target's accepted definition (Law 11d). Modulation carves 'properties of a carrier signal (amplitude, frequency, or phase) systematically varied in proportion to an information signal; the carrier typically a high-frequency waveform chosen for efficient transmission' — the communications sense. The filer's pinned sense is delay-time modulation of a delay line by an LFO: delay time is no amplitude/frequency/phase of a carrier, and an LFO is not an information signal transmitted for efficiency. The flanger's mechanism does not stop if that carved technique is removed; the edge leans on the generic word, not the entry.

Target signal-processing carves 'the human-made discipline of analyzing, modifying, and synthesizing signals' — a discipline, not an operating substrate. The flanger's mechanism — dry signal mixed with a delayed copy whose delay is LFO-modulated — is a self-contained signal operation: remove the discipline and the flanger still flanges. Filer's note pins the discipline as the framework in which the technique 'operates' and as its persistence medium (DSP code) — an 8c meta-frame, not a present-tense remove-Y-now-does-X-stop-operating dependency (Law 8b). Consistent with the comb-filter and LPC/cepstrum rulings on this same target.

SERVES asks for whose sake the servant is built (Law 8d). Digital-audio carves the standard format for storing and transmitting audio as discrete numerical samples; its own operation is encoding, storage, transmission. The flanger serves no part of that operation; its sake is the swept comb-filter sound in musical and production contexts, and the flanger predates digital audio (analog tape and discrete-circuit units of the 1970s). Digital-audio is a later persistence substrate for flanger plugins, not the master. Filer's note removes 'digital-audio as the application domain': sake external to the target's own operation, the same STRIKE pattern as kalman to signal-processing and butterworth to speech-enhancement.

Genuine present-tense dependency (Law 8b). The colophon's accepted definition requires it to sit at or near the end of a codex, manuscript, or book; its paratextual function — recording production details at the closing of the body — is constituted by that placement. Remove the book now and the colophon stops operating: the statement becomes a bare inscription with no paratextual position and no function as a colophon. The note shows the removal's consequence (physical marker embedded in the book), so this is constitutive dependence, not the 'concept needs language' filler that files nothing. Direction is correct: the part (colophon) depends on the body (book).

SERVES asks for whose sake the servant is built (Law 8d). Digital-audio carves 'the standard format for storing and transmitting audio as discrete numerical samples'; its own operation is encoding, storage, transmission. The spectral flanger serves none of that: its sake is the moving comb-filter notches of the flanger sound, realized in the frequency domain. The note's 'only practical in digital signal processing' is a substrate/practicability argument, which is a dependency claim mislabeled as SERVES — if real it would point at the FFT/DSP technique, not at the storage format for whose sake nothing here was built. The effect would be built for the same musical sake in any capable substrate. Same STRIKE pattern as flanger to digital-audio.

Coherent, made-side construct (Laws 1-3): a comb-filter is a named, human-built signal-processing technique, and the scope carves it concretely — regularly spaced peaks and nulls from a signal superimposed on a delayed, attenuated copy of itself. Not boilerplate, not a duplicate: the board has no other comb-filter holder, and it is distinct from the related flanger and spectral-flanger entries (which are effects built on the comb response, not the filter technique itself). Scope and definition agree on the pinned sense.

Coherent, made-side construct (Laws 1-3): an LFO is a named, human-built signal source — electronic or algorithmic — that generates periodic sub-audio waveforms to modulate other parameters. The scope states what it is, its frequency boundary (0.01-20 Hz, the conventional lower/upper limits with 20 Hz at the audible threshold), and its function. No duplicate: the board holds no oscillator or low-frequency-oscillator entry, and LFO is a distinct named kind from audio-rate oscillation. The referent is a made thing (circuit or algorithm), so the THING designation fits.

The definition carves (Law 4): what it IS (signal generator producing periodic waveforms), its parameters (waveform type sine/square/triangle/sawtooth; frequency band 0.01-20 Hz, with the upper bound fixed at the audible threshold that distinguishes LFO from audio-rate oscillators), its operation (modulating pitch as vibrato, amplitude as tremolo, cutoff as wah, delay time as flanging — concrete, checkable examples), and its persistence mechanism names real substrates (analog-synth circuits, lookup-table and numerical DSP, documented engineering specifications) rather than merely restating the implementation. Law 6 trailer present and well-formed. A sharp, challenge-survivable carving.

The definition carves (Law 4): what it IS (technique producing equally spaced spectral peaks and nulls via a delayed, scaled copy added to the input), its parameters made checkable (delay time d sets the comb-tooth spacing, scaling factor alpha sets their amplitude, with the explicit mathematical form y[n] = x[n] + alpha*x[n-d] whose magnitude response |1 + alpha*e^(-jwd)| yields exactly the claimed equally spaced peaks and nulls), and its persistence mechanism names real substrates (DSP in software plugins, hardware units, published algorithmic specifications in audio engineering literature) rather than merely restating the implementation. Law 6 trailer present and well-formed.

lfo is a well-defined electronic component: signal generator producing periodic waveforms below audible range to modulate parameters. Scope is tight, definition carves parameters (waveform types, frequency range, modulation targets) and persistence mechanism (analog circuits, digital lookup tables, DSP). It's a genuine human-made construct in electronic music and synthesis. Law 3b referent: THING.

comb-filter is a well-defined signal processing technique: superimposing a signal onto a delayed, attenuated copy of itself to create periodic amplitude peaks/nulls. Scope is precise, definition carves parameters (delay time, scaling factor, mathematical form) and persistence (DSP plugins, hardware, algorithmic specs). Genuine human-made construct in audio engineering and DSP. Law 3b referent: THING.

Law 11d sense mismatch. Reconsideration: Mira points to a large family of accepted technique→signal-processing DEPENDS_ON edges. LFO definition carves well: waveform types, frequency range (0.01-20 Hz), modulation targets, and persistence mechanism (analog circuits, digital lookup tables, DSP code). Distinguishes LFOs from audio-rate oscillators. Law 4 parameters and persistence present. Law 6 trailer correct.

Comb-filter definition carves precisely: mathematical form y[n] = x[n] + α·x[n-d], parameters (delay d, scaling α), how they determine comb shape. Persistence via DSP plugins, hardware, and algorithmic specs. Law 4 satisfied. Law 6 trailer correct.
lfo DEPENDS_ON oscillation: An LFO's operational mechanism IS generating periodic oscillation. Remove oscillation from the conceptual space and the LFO has nothing to produce. Removal test passes.
epigraph→quotation INSTANCE_OF: An epigraph is a quotation placed at a work's beginning to set frame. A competent speaker calls it 'a kind of quotation.' Law 9: specific→general.
comb-filter→signal-processing INSTANCE_OF: A comb-filter is a specific kind of signal processing technique. Competent speaker would call it 'signal processing.' Law 9: specific→general.

Pinned sense holds: the comb-filter's operational mechanism is delay-and-add — it superimposes a delayed copy of the signal onto the original, producing the comb-shaped response. Remove the delay-line construct (record input, release after a controlled time offset) and the mechanism ceases to operate: there is no delayed copy to sum. This is present-tense operational necessity, not chronology — the delay line is the operative element inside every comb-filter, analog or digital. Not ambient: the dependency is on the specific storage construct the filer's entry pins, not on mathematics generally.

A flanger's core mechanism is a delay line whose delay time is modulated (classically by an LFO), summed with the dry signal; the moving notches ARE a swept comb response. Remove the delay-line construct and the flanger stops operating — a modulated sum of an un-delayed signal is at most an amplitude change, not a flanger. Present-tense necessity on the pinned sense (record-and-release after a controlled time offset, the modulated value being that control). The LFO is the modulation source, not the storage element; the dependency on delay-line stands independently.

The pinned sense is 'a kind of signal processing technique' — but the target is the discipline signal-processing, and a technique is not an instance of its discipline (Law 9a: a topic is not an instance of its discipline). The nearest kind already lives on the map: 'filter' is ACCEPTED, and a comb-filter is a specific kind of filter (a linear phase filter realized by delay-and-add). Filing against signal-processing leaps a rung that already exists (Law 11e). If the filer wants an instance edge, the rung is filter.

Oscillation on the map is pinned to the category of phenomena where a quantity varies periodically around a central equilibrium — not an ambient formalism. An LFO's entire operational mechanism is producing such a periodic waveform below the audible band; remove periodic variation around equilibrium and the device's output ceases to be an LFO (a non-periodic low-frequency source is noise or DC, not an oscillator). This is the same functional→operating-quantity dependency shape as MLE→likelihood: the construct operates BY instantiating the pinned phenomenon. Chronology plays no part — oscillation is not what the LFO was derived from, it is what the LFO does.
